title: Club Committee
introText:
The club is managed entirely by a volunteer committee of current members.

Meeting bi-monthly, they are responsible for day-to-day running of club activities, future development planning, financial management and ensuring the club meets all standards of best practice and duty of care as set by England Athletics and London Borough of Waltham Forest.

You’ll be able to find out more about each committee role and get in touch using the links below. Check back in a few days.

[EMA Club Structure 2022/23](/uploads/documents/EMA-Club-Structure-2022-23.pdf)
